page.overview:
Who is Komakkov?

"Winter Cuisine" Komakkov is a chef under the employment of the Marines as one of its Four Head Chefs.

Komakkov appears to be a portly, wrinkled, middle-aged man with a prominent nose and chin, as well as long, wavy black hair. He wears a relatively small chef's hat and a pair of dark-lensed goggles.

Not much is known about Komakkov's personality.

Komakkov is one of the four elite chefs within the employment of the Marines, so he is likely considered a very talented cook. As further acknowledgment of his skills, he was trusted with cooking for Jaygarcia Saturn, one of the Five Elders, during his escort trip to Egghead.
